FICTIONAL SUPPLY AGREEMENT

Clause 17 — Notice and mitigation

The supplier shall notify the purchaser within five business days after the supplier discovers a material breach. The supplier need not notify the purchaser if the purchaser already knew of that breach. This exception does not apply when the supplier concealed it. Each party shall then take reasonable measures without undue delay where appropriate.

This text is a synthetic ambiguity fixture. It is not legal authority.
